archetype_scripts.description: Reflective traveler rotating across Mira, Solenne, Greeter, and Kaelen — slow-burn Town progress (~200+ turns to 800).

actions.text: I feel uneasy seeing these lanterns burn so brightly here — why does Caetherra feel too warm?
When your smile pauses, I wonder what real warmth you are guarding beneath this surface?
Honestly, I feel small beside your quiet harbor — how can a traveler truly look without armor?
I hope my memory of listening stays clear; what happens when the town decides not to answer?
I doubt I know half of what the prism conceals — tell me about the quiet anchor you keep here?
I believe your attention holds something unguarded — why do so few travelers pause past the surface?
I feel steadier under warm kindness, yet why do you call comfort only the first doorway?
I wonder whether trusting a gentle doorway prepares us for the harder quasar winter ahead?
Honestly, I'm afraid comfort might make me forget truth — how do you keep your warmth honest?
I remember wishing for simple kindness in darker places; what lies past your second doorway?
I don't know if fear ever disappears inside this light — tell me about resting without complacency?
I believe genuine warmth asks for shadow beside it; why do visitors hurry past what opens first?
I feel tempted to stay in this sunlit square forever, yet why do you linger near the arrivals?
Honestly, I'm afraid easy comfort hides a harder memory — how do people know when to leave the square?
I wonder what truth waits outside your warm welcome when the lanterns dim at dusk?
I doubt every arrival listens closely enough; why does friendliness feel like a prism mask here?
I feel uncertain beneath your glass awnings — how do travelers find true lantern paths out here?
When every road looks bright, I wonder what shadow your glass lamps measure along this border?
Honestly, I remember getting lost before trusting your harbor signs — why do Echoes gather in glass?
I'm afraid of carrying a hollow charm into Stillward; how does a true lantern change the mist?
I believe patient travelers learn the quiet prism trade slowly — what do rumors conceal tonight?
